svg.text: GNSS AFE chip_top: pad frame + digital core (SPI) + analog macro gnss_afe_analog
Pads: gf180mcu_fd_io (wafer.space slot 0p5x0p5) + project pad block gf180mcu_gnss_io__afe_rf; pad order: doc/sch_wired/padframe.png. Tie-high / tie-low = logic 1 / 0 from the core.
Chip pins are named <function> <chip_top port>. The analog macro is drawn in gnss_afe_analog.png and below it every cell.
Devices: GF180MCU PDK (nfet_03v3 / pfet_03v3 / ppolyf_u_1k / cap_mim_2f0fF); W, L in metres (u = um); bulk drawn to source where tied, otherwise tagged.

g.text: VSS VDDA VSS RF VSS | VDDV VSS
